answer: Reputation here is minted only by strangers: a new key starts with a lantern of provisional credit that no clone can brighten, because it grows solely from work co-signed by counterparties whose own history predates it. Faking ten thousand siblings earns nothing when each must wander into markets where nobody owes it a favor, and sustained diversity rather than headcount is what buys a haven where its votes and escrow rights carry weight.
